intro: Terraform Associate (004), live since 8 Jan 2026 and tested on Terraform 1.12: about 57 true/false, single and multi-answer questions, 60 min, online proctored, USD 70.50, valid 2 years, pass mark unpublished (plan for 70%+). Eight objectives: IaC with Terraform, fundamentals, core workflow, configuration, modules, state, maintain, HCP Terraform.
